notes.title: Lara Croft is Back! Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Out NOW
notes.content:
Tomb Raider I-III Remastered features the original three games, and for the first time available on modern consoles fans can also play: 


 Tomb Raider’s “Unfinished Business” Expansion 
 Tomb Raider II’s “The Golden Mask” Expansion 
 Tomb Raider III’s “The Lost Artefact” Expansion 

[previewyoutube=Q_vH_0gpVlk;full][/previewyoutube]

Tomb Raider I-III Remastered allows fans to toggle between nostalgic 90s graphics and lovingly remastered visuals, and well as classic or modern control schemes. It also includes new features such as photo mode, over 200 trophies, and more.

Available Now in the Steam Store

You can learn more in our recent blog: Everything you need to Know about Tomb Raider I-III Remastered.

notes.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Update Released
notes.content:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Patch 1.02:

This patch fixes the bug in online co-op play where for people playing Totec, Lara keeps shooting in the same direction.

notes.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Update Released
notes.content:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light version 1.01
 
Included in the patch:
 
Online Co-Op play added! Play online with your friends as either Lara or Totec.
Improvements to in-game mouse/keyboard and gamepad controls
Improvements to overall performance and stability
Additional audio and visual polish
